lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, organized into roughly five visible vertical columns with varying inter-spot distances.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the primary spot centroids, creating a visible nodal grid structure along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge visible along the upper-mid flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of smaller, less-defined high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin and the cranial region anterior to the gills.
